title: Dexcom reporting high for over 45 minutes turns off loop
symptom: When Dexcom reports a high reading (e.g., 22.3 mmol) that remains constant for over 45 minutes, the loop is disabled. This occurs when using xDrip as a source, but not when using the patched Dexcom app.
cause: The loop is disabled due to logic that prevents a Libre issue, but this logic is not applied when using xDrip as a source. The maintainer states that xDrip is not trusted as a source because it is complex and data can be faked.
fix: No fix was provided. The maintainer suggests using the Dexcom app along with xDrip, and notes that manual action may be needed for high BG levels.
evidence_quote: xDrip is very complex and it's possible to fake the data. Thus only Dexcom app is accepted as trusted source now
